mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.5% compresses equity discount rates through reduced borrowing costs, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active at all times with the rate level as the sole driver.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of unemployment below 3.5% and payroll growth exceeding 150.0 thousand persons signals labor market overheating, triggering inflationary expectations and subsequent monetary tightening that produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS > 150.0), or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, housing starts above 1400 and retail sales above 700000 signal economic peak conditions, leading to profit-taking and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST>1400, RSAFS>700000, and the regime is late-cycle, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings visibility and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines month-over-month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1400 indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, compressing equity discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active at all times with the level as the sole driver.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above 1400, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High annual inflation (CPIAUCSL annual change > 3.5%) combined with a stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 4.3%) signals persistent inflation without adequate monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL annual change > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS <= 4.3), or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
